$comment: v6.3 D12a minimal rule and obligation registry. Rules: kind legacy may carry outcome_contract 'pending' (evaluated as unverified); kind new or changed needs reason codes for all five states. V cases: per slice part, status not-run | expected-failure | required-before-enforcement | passing; expected-failure and passing name the tests that run them. Impact groups map changed paths to test modules or run_all_checks parts; a not-available check, an unmatched path or a full group forces the full closure.

prerequisites: effect_keys (recipe 1.1.0) or upstream extension.corrections[] R4 keys
rules.applicability: every second application of one effect along a recipe and its upstream records
rules.notes: contracts/recipe_semantics.py _walk/apply with _same_application; maps to R-REP (C3) once its adapter exists

rules.applicability: recipes checked with upstream artifacts, or claiming applied input effects
rules.notes: contracts/recipe_semantics.py upstream_instances; a record that cannot be mapped keeps a repeat open
contracts/recipe_semantics.py: keys only from 1.1.0, each key names an applied effect

v_cases.scenario: One more consistent description of the same application
v_cases.expected: Application count and verdict unchanged

v_cases.scenario: Descriptions of the same operation differ in calibration
v_cases.expected: Description conflict checked with or without application_id; legacy finding kept separately

v_cases.scenario: The same slot applied twice on the same path
v_cases.expected: violated

v_cases.scenario: Two alternative branches, each applied once
v_cases.expected: Not judged a repeat only with explicit branch and root bindings

v_cases.scenario: One recipe template builds 4 instances
v_cases.expected: Template listed once; instance view has sources; missing values can be filled, overriding literals is rejected

v_cases.scenario: A shared parameter acts on several channels with one auxiliary observation
v_cases.expected: satisfied; consistent with the adapter result

v_cases.scenario: The same auxiliary observation enters one joint likelihood under two aux IDs
v_cases.expected: violated when source and use are known; unverified when a binding is missing

v_cases.scenario: Same source type, different instances
v_cases.expected: Not merged

v_cases.scenario: A parent described by its children, with one operation only
v_cases.expected: Not double counted under a listed composition contract

v_cases.scenario: The parent and its full decomposition each applied once
v_cases.expected: violated

v_cases.scenario: A required response, scope or observation binding is missing
v_cases.expected: Obligation kept, coverage partial; a deleted frozen file is also reported as invalid

v_cases.scenario: The full inputs show a response is genuinely not needed
v_cases.expected: not_applicable only when applicability is false

v_cases.scenario: Old and new alias keys with equal values; a conflict in the same file
v_cases.expected: Equal values resolve the same; a conflict is rejected; the original file is unchanged

v_cases.scenario: Adopting a new catalog or alias version
v_cases.expected: New lock and subject; in M2a the old subject is unverified

v_cases.scenario: Renaming files or reordering set enumerations
v_cases.expected: Ordered steps and bin arrays are not reordered; unrelated changes do not alter the semantic verdict

v_cases.scenario: Scope changes only as an opaque string
v_cases.expected: Legacy warning kept; new suite unverified

v_cases.scenario: An operator from an old semantics table
v_cases.expected: Mapped through the pinned operator semantics

v_cases.scenario: An unsupported operator or modifier
v_cases.expected: unsupported; cannot be inferred as a pass from the absence of a legacy finding

v_cases.scenario: Updating references from leaf to root
v_cases.expected: References consistent, original files unchanged, no completion marker on failure

v_cases.scenario: Adding results after execution
v_cases.expected: Bundle unchanged, no circular digest, result identity and scope verified

v_cases.scenario: Two operations on the same path with the same scope and variation but different calibrations
v_cases.expected: Both legacy and new suite judge it a repeat; distinguished from a description conflict

v_cases.scenario: Incomplete keys
v_cases.expected: Old entry point repeat_undetermined; new report unverified

v_cases.scenario: A description cannot be mapped uniquely to a step within one instance
v_cases.expected: unverified; not merged and not judged a violation

v_cases.scenario: Masking a required binding or removing a listed file under the same frozen intent
v_cases.expected: Obligations do not disappear and coverage does not rise; removing a file fails integrity

v_cases.scenario: Context directly declares a rule not applicable
v_cases.expected: Not counted; only verifiable applicability facts can affect the verdict

v_cases.scenario: A scoped exception
v_cases.expected: Original finding kept; non-waivable items rejected

v_cases.scenario: Several input errors and incompleteness at once
v_cases.expected: By 2 > 1 > 3 > 0, distinguishing an unreadable top level, a missing frozen file and a missing external dependency

v_cases.scenario: An old ratio with free-text numerator and denominator
v_cases.expected: Ratio rule unverified

v_cases.scenario: An alias taking over across owners, or a cycle
v_cases.expected: Rejected

v_cases.scenario: Controlled, unknown and public local profiles missing metadata
v_cases.expected: Per transition stage; existing controlled refusals not relaxed

v_cases.scenario: Old contract_version, non-strict
v_cases.expected: New rules appear only in the shadow report

v_cases.scenario: A non-lock alias used at run time
v_cases.expected: Rejected when the lock bound in the result binding differs from the actual semantics; merely installing a new version while the old snapshot is available is not drift (needs D11b)

v_cases.scenario: An execution read an input that is neither frozen nor from a legitimate producer
v_cases.expected: violated

v_cases.scenario: The response is used for unfolding, but the recipe handles migration with not_applied
v_cases.expected: violated (R-RESP)

v_cases.scenario: Trigger and selection against effective exposure
v_cases.expected: realized only with listed operator coverage; the classification alone is not enough

parts.host: effect catalog and coverage contract (definition part)

v_cases.scenario: A spec correction carrying supported R4 fields
v_cases.expected: The new version no longer reports unknown_key; old versions follow the threshold

v_cases.scenario: A description without a scope against 4 instances
v_cases.expected: Needs explicit applicability or an instance mapping; no automatic broadcast

v_cases.scenario: An execution reads JSON inside the bundle
v_cases.expected: Bytes and canonical digests each verified; re-serialization treated as a derived input

v_cases.scenario: An ID points to a step whose stage, effect or calibration does not match
v_cases.expected: violated even though locating succeeded

v_cases.scenario: Different scope strings with no basis for mutual exclusion
v_cases.expected: New suite unverified; old warning kept

v_cases.scenario: Two mutually exclusive selections from one file; mutual exclusion declared for the same selection
v_cases.expected: The former can hold; the latter is violated

v_cases.scenario: Repeated axis, unknown value, missing axis
v_cases.expected: Illegal grammar rejected; missing information is not a wildcard

v_cases.scenario: A new efficiency member not included in operator coverage
v_cases.expected: Cannot be realized automatically

parts.host: effect catalog and coverage contract (definition part)

v_cases.scenario: Different bins of the same calibration table, versus a common scalar
v_cases.expected: The former does not cancel exactly; the latter cancels when the conditions hold

v_cases.scenario: independent or verification given only as a bare claim
v_cases.expected: unverified

v_cases.scenario: Alternative models reusing an observation, versus multiplying it again in a joint likelihood
v_cases.expected: The former is not a repeat; the latter is violated, and unknown is unverified

v_cases.scenario: Cross-model sharing binds incompatible parameters or constraints
v_cases.expected: Merge rejected; unknown parametrization is unsupported or unverified

v_cases.scenario: Only not_applied written, with no prediction-side folding use
v_cases.expected: Cannot claim the response was handled

v_cases.scenario: A variation renamed but its output still rejoins the nominal path
v_cases.expected: Repeat judged from data flow

v_cases.scenario: Deleting a root and re-freezing a smaller analysis
v_cases.expected: New subject and scope delta; old assessments and permits not inherited

v_cases.scenario: No legacy finding, but a required rule did not run
v_cases.expected: unverified; the obligation inventory cannot become empty and pass

v_cases.scenario: Inputs that cannot be established, versus a completed evaluation with a violation
v_cases.expected: The former is invalid and partial; the latter is complete and inconsistent

v_cases.scenario: A product of run A used by run B
v_cases.expected: A legitimate intermediate-product closure passes; provenance binding and bytes checked

v_cases.scenario: A failed single execution leaves output, or several retries
v_cases.expected: Not promoted to success; the result binding names the one adopted

v_cases.scenario: Ambiguous product producer, run cycle, the same bytes in a different role
v_cases.expected: Rejected, or an explicit binding required

v_cases.scenario: A complete but self-reported input manifest
v_cases.expected: Claims only manifest consistency (declared level)

v_cases.scenario: The environment has a new version and the complete old snapshot is still available
v_cases.expected: Reproduced from the old snapshot; only an actual swap is drift

v_cases.scenario: An updated class set affects wildcard resolution
v_cases.expected: Set-query dependencies go into the lock; unrelated definitions do not change the semantic closure

parts.host: effect catalog and coverage contract (definition part)

v_cases.scenario: An old reader ignores required_capabilities
v_cases.expected: The matrix exposes it; not released before a real refusal threshold exists

v_cases.scenario: A hand-edited pass report, wrong suite, stale assessment, requirement before report, or a permit whose execution bundle differs from the result binding's
v_cases.expected: permit.py's advisory check rejects wrong bindings; pre- and post-conditions by purpose

v_cases.scenario: One chunk of a campaign has two valid outputs
v_cases.expected: Only the one the collection record names is adopted; the duplicate enters neither merge nor root

v_cases.scenario: A chunk output digest in the result binding disagrees with the collection record; or the campaign lacks collected or has an orphan output
v_cases.expected: The former is violated; the latter counts only as declared, with related obligations unverified

v_cases.scenario: Submissions owning collected attempts lack a bundle digest, disagree with each other, or disagree with the result binding
v_cases.expected: The first two get no campaign-recorded level; the last is violated; a campaign with the same name does not pass

v_cases.scenario: An obligation is satisfied only through an agent's unconfirmed declaration
v_cases.expected: Diagnostics flag it declaration-based; formal use treats it as unverified

v_cases.scenario: The evidence of an accepted review includes the report
v_cases.expected: Declaration-based obligations count for formal use

v_cases.scenario: Only a pass report, no accepted review
v_cases.expected: permit.py rejects; the custodian gate rejects under the same requirement

v_cases.scenario: The inventory regenerated under the same suite version differs
v_cases.expected: input invalid

v_cases.scenario: A new suite version adds obligations
v_cases.expected: New assessment, listing obligations added and removed

v_cases.scenario: A factor check across many bins
v_cases.expected: One obligation per relation, bin results summarized, report within budget

v_cases.scenario: A blinded spec's result binding points at observed results
v_cases.expected: Rejected; only asimov or synthetic statuses, or outputs matching blinding.allowed_outputs under D05d's matching rule, are accepted; reports and summaries carry no values

v_cases.scenario: hep-measurement's review calls the check
v_cases.expected: Summary within budget and names the missing bindings; instruction text passes routing and text checks

not_available: masking tests on a fixed subject (D05b)
scope delta for a new subject (D05b)
bytes and canonical digests of the new bundle (D05b)

impact.change: core/partition or batch adapter record fields
not_available: fake-scheduler and LocalExecutor campaign cases (D08 run)

impact.change: design and decision records, changelog, validation record
